english.note: This is the all-purpose verb used before the name of the transport, as in 上車, 上船, or 上機.

examples.english: We can board the boat now.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 soeng5 syun4 laa1

english.note: Use 上 as the all-purpose verb for moving up or getting onto something, including stairs, a horse, or a vehicle.
Use this as the all-purpose verb for going up or reaching a higher place or position when hands-and-feet climbing is not meant.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 soeng5 maa5 sin1 laa1

examples.english: We need to climb upstairs for a meeting.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 soeng5 lau4 soeng5 hoi1 wui2
